Standard: In the landing approach flight phase, the air vehicle flight path angle versus true airspeed slope is no greater than 0.15 degrees per knot, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's steady-state flight path and airspeed response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Steady-State Flight-Path Response to Pitch Controller paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's steady-state flight path and airspeed response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Steady-State Flight-Path Response to Pitch Controller paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's steady-state flight path and airspeed response as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Steady-State Flight-Path Response to Pitch Controller paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states and environmental conditions.
